release_summary: More reliable message delivery and review, a compact delivery centre, and responsive information and software-update cards.
features: Compact delivery control with counts instead of a persistent full-width warning bar
Delivery centre shows destination, saved message, time, attempts and recovery guidance
Administrator-authorized dismissal of reviewed chat notices with retained audit evidence
Measured responsive cards for Information and Software Update screens
fixes: Refresh corrected recipient directories instead of trusting stale ambiguous names
Hold unexpected successful HTTP responses for review instead of automatically repeating a possibly accepted message
Route new support calls through the current connector without changing existing incident routing
Allow reviewed, unexpired help requests to be retried from the delivery screen
Make stale help notices reviewable during outages or quota pauses, and do not claim external delivery in standalone mode
Do not mistake ordinary message text containing local: for a pending record identifier
Confirm help delivery only after the service response has been saved
security: Message dismissal never removes incident records, equipment transitions or active deliveries
Uncertain non-idempotent writes remain protected against automatic duplicate retries
No connector credentials or customer setup are included in source, captures or build output
